problem: Viable Australian businesses can face payroll, repair, replacement-stock and reopening costs while an insurance claim remains under assessment, without a borrower-focused framework for separating liquidity finance from claim escalation.

targeting.primaryQuery: working capital finance insurance claim delay Australia
targeting.audience: Australian companies and business operators managing a commercial insurance claim delay

uniqueValue: Maps claim-delay spending into an evidence-led weekly funding schedule rather than treating an expected payout as guaranteed cash.
Keeps lender assessment, insurer complaints, AFCA escalation and legal advice as distinct pathways.

evidence.summary: Australian results explain claim-delay processes but provide little business-borrower guidance on funding payroll, repairs, stock and reopening costs.
AFCA's official insurance complaint pathway keeps external dispute resolution separate from commercial finance.

measurement.successRule: Evidence of non-brand impressions/clicks or assisted service-page engagement at review.
measurement.exitRule: Consolidate or noindex only after complete review evidence shows persistent low value or material intent overlap.

approval.basis: Approved daily content cron policy and auto_queued brave_fortnightly queue item.
